observations: The page number «XX» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. L01-L04 end no. 11, begun at the foot of p. XIX (JP2 0023, L37-L38): N gives the conjunctions and oppositions also for the years 541 and 571, which Suter does not reproduce.

The notes of N are quoted in italics, with Suter's words in roman between them; «(?)» (L06) upright. L20: the a of «mediam» is of a different design from the italic a of the line, taller and more upright, a sort of another fount; transcribed as a. The colons and semicolons of the Latin stand after the thin space of the edition, as in the German (6-13 px measured).
N03: «Im Text mediates»: the text of the note has «mediates», which the quotation (L33) gives as «medietates».
